summary: Frontend QA pass for 'Model Build' upgrade (12 review-request checkpoints). Tested at desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 375x800. 10/12 checkpoints PASS. 2 minor copy/asset issues found: (a) en-dashes still present inside the /contact 'Preferred Contact Time' dropdown options, (b) 3 partner logo images (ADNOC, DP World, Dubai Holding) fail to load because logo.clearbit.com is unreachable from the preview env (ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED), so they render as text-only fallbacks. All new interactive features (hero booking widget, Live Trust Signal, Fleet Savings Calculator, Mobile Contact Bar) function correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown options 'Morning (9am–12pm)', 'Afternoon (12pm–4pm)', 'Evening (4pm–7pm)' contain en-dashes (–) in visible body text. Spec requires zero hyphens/en/em-dashes in copy. Replace with standard hyphen-minus '-' or word 'to' (e.g., '9am to 12pm').

Line 397 iframe title="It's not just a fleet — It's the scale and innovation of Eurogulf Mobility Group" contains an em-dash. Not user-visible body text but exposed to screen-readers/SEO crawlers. Replace with '.' or ':'.

integration_issues.flow: Homepage 'Trusted by the UAE's Most Recognised Names' partner logo strip
integration_issues.issue: 3 of 7 partner logo images (ADNOC, DP World, Dubai Holding) all sourced from https://logo.clearbit.com/* return net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED in this preview environment. The onError fallback inline span (line 253) displays the brand name as text, plus the bottom label (line 255) shows the name, so the 7 named partners DO appear textually, but visually the spec calls for actual logos. Recommend self-hosting these 3 logos (download once, place under /public, swap URL) — same approach used for Europcar (/europcar-logo.png) — to remove the third-party DNS dependency and ensure the logos always render.

verified_working: Homepage hero dual-action widget: [data-testid='hero-booking-widget'] renders. B2C button (Private Journey) Link href=/book-chauffeur navigates correctly. B2B button (Corporate Solutions) Link href=/contact navigates correctly. Labels exactly match spec.
Live Trust Signal bar [data-testid='trust-signal']: contains '12,000+ Vehicles', '1,200+ Professionals', 'Moving the UAE since 1976' on orange background directly below hero.

Partner logos section [data-testid='partner-logos-section']: 7 cards rendered with correct data-testid (al-khoory-automobiles, imt-dubai, europcar, adnoc, emirates, dp-world, dubai-holding). 4 logos load successfully (Al Khoory, IMT, Europcar, Emirates). All 7 have visible text labels under the logo slot (line 255).

Mobile contact bar at 375x800: [data-testid='mobile-contact-bar'] visible, WhatsApp href=https://wa.me/97145063030, Call href=tel:800364. Hidden on desktop (md:hidden class confirmed, is_visible()=False at 1920px).
Layout main has pb-14 md:pb-0 spacing — verified in App.js line 60 — preventing mobile bar from overlapping content.

Leasing page Fleet Savings Calculator: H2 'Fleet Savings Calculator' rendered. Slider 1→50→100 updates saving (AED 49,572 → 3,304,800 → 6,609,600). Term dropdown 36→60 months updates saving (AED 660,960 → 1,101,600 and label 'Estimated 60-month saving'). Vehicle class dropdown updates saving (660,960 → 2,592,000 for Luxury). All three controls dynamically update.
Services page (/services) hero H1 = 'Mobility Engineered for the UAE' (matches spec; not 'Our Services' or 'Mobility Solutions for Every Need').
About page (/about) hero H1 = 'A Legacy of Movement' (matches spec; not 'About EGMG' or 'A Connected Mobility Ecosystem').
No 'EGMG' abbreviation in public-facing text. document.body.innerText 'EGMG' check on /, /about, /services, /leasing, /contact = all False. EGMG_LOGO is only a JS variable name (allowed per spec).

No em-dashes (—) or en-dashes (–) in heading or body text on /, /about, /services, /leasing (verified via document.body.innerText scan). One exception found on /contact (dropdown options) — flagged above.
Service descriptions end with specific CTA buttons — verified Europcar (Get a Quote etc), Chauffeur (Submit Transport Enquiry), Leasing (Customize Your Lease) per prior iteration_15.

SEO meta titles use pipe separators (|) — verified on /, /about, /services, /leasing, /contact. Zero em-dashes in <title>. Sample: 'Eurogulf Mobility Group | Integrated Mobility Solutions UAE | Since 1976'.

Footer logo alt='Eurogulf Mobility Group' (Footer.js line 31). Navigation top-bar alt='Eurogulf Mobility Group' (Navigation.js line 137). Nav dropdown trigger label 'About Eurogulf' (Navigation.js line 204) — no bare 'EGMG'.
Mobile bar at 375px confirmed via fixed-position bottom bar with two equal-width tappable areas (WhatsApp + Call), grid-cols-2, bg-black/95 backdrop-blur, border-[#EE5A01]/30.
action_items: (LOW) ContactPage.js line 205: replace en-dashes in the Preferred Contact Time dropdown options ('Morning (9am–12pm)' → 'Morning (9am to 12pm)' or use ASCII hyphen). Apply to all 3 time-range entries.
(LOW) HomePage.js line 397: replace em-dash in iframe title with '.' or ':' so a11y/SEO copy is also dash-free.

(MEDIUM) Replace 3 logo.clearbit.com URLs (ADNOC, DP World, Dubai Holding) in HomePage.js PARTNER_LOGOS with self-hosted images under /public to remove third-party DNS dependency. Currently the preview environment cannot resolve logo.clearbit.com so these logos render as text-only fallback — production may have the same restriction.
(OPTIONAL) Consider hiding the bottom duplicate label span (line 255) when the inline fallback span (line 253) becomes visible to avoid showing the brand name twice when an image fails.
critical_code_review_comments: PARTNER_LOGOS dependency on external CDN (logo.clearbit.com) is fragile — already failing in preview env. Self-host or proxy through the site CDN for production reliability.
Both an inline fallback span (line 253) and a bottom permanent label (line 255) carry the same brand name; when image fails, the name appears twice. Minor visual duplication on broken-image cards.

ContactPage time options should be centralised into a single constants module (along with PARTNER_LOGOS, brand-name strings, and the color tokens called out in iteration_15) to make future copy/dash-cleanup grep-able and to prevent regression.
Em-dash in iframe title attribute slipped past the dash-removal sweep — a CI grep guard (e.g. eslint rule or git pre-commit) blocking — and – in /app/frontend/src/**/*.js would prevent recurrence.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% — 10/12 spec checkpoints fully pass, 2 partial (dashes still present in 1 dropdown + 1 iframe title; 3 partner logo images fail to load in this env but text labels render)

test_credentials: Admin CMS credentials provided (admin@egmg.ae / EgmgAdmin2026!) were NOT exercised — frontend public-pages QA only per testing_type='frontend only(skip backend)'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 'Model Build' interactive features (hero booking widget, Live Trust Signal, Fleet Savings Calculator, Mobile Contact Bar) are functionally correct and wired up with proper data-testid attributes. Remaining cleanup items are pure copy/asset fixes: (1) ContactPage.js line 205 — en-dashes in time-range dropdown; (2) HomePage.js line 397 — em-dash in iframe title; (3) 3 partner logo URLs from clearbit.com need to be self-hosted. After fixes, retest /contact dropdown text and partner logo image load on /. Backend was not exercised.
rca of the issue: Partner logo image fail RCA: the URLs https://logo.clearbit.com/{adnoc.ae|dpworld.com|dubaiholding.com}?size=200 return ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED inside the preview cluster (3 console errors logged). The onError handler in HomePage.js line 251 hides the img and unhides the sibling text-fallback span, so the page does not crash; but the spec expectation 'partner logos for Al Khoory, IMT, Europcar, ADNOC, Emirates, DP World, Dubai Holding' is only partially met visually. Mitigation: download each PNG/SVG once, place under /public/partners/, and update the PARTNER_LOGOS array URLs — same pattern already used for /europcar-logo.png which loads reliably. Dashes RCA: copy sweep removed —/– from headings and body paragraphs but missed (a) one iframe title attribute string-literal and (b) the static option strings inside ContactPage.js Select dropdown. Add a CI grep guard `grep -nP '[—–]' frontend/src/**/*.{js,jsx}` to block reintroduction.
